text:
Ashley M.: Hey team, ACME reported that their daily usage CSV for 2025-11-19 is empty in the exports but our dashboard shows ~120k tokens. They said invoice also omitted that day's usage. Can we triage?
Matt R.: ack. Do we have the export job id or S3 path from the customer?
Ashley M.: Customer pasted the S3 URL they downloaded: s3://redwood-exports/prod/tenant-ACME/2025-11-19/usage-ACME-2025-11-19.csv (file size 0 bytes). They also attached the portal row/graph screenshot showing normal traffic.
Jordan (data-eng): Hmm. 0-byte CSV means the manifest wrote an empty file for that shard/day. Need to check aggregator/worker run for that hour/day window. Any recent deploys to hourly-aggregator?
Priya N.: I can pull the export job logs. Ashley, can you confirm the tenant id and whether they use incremental vs compact export?
Ashley M.: Tenant ACME corp, tenant_id 981234. They use the default daily compact export. Billing said invoice generation for 2025-11-20 shows a gap (missing 11-19).
Matt R.: billing-bot, did invoice job reference the export manifest or raw ledger? billing-bot: Invoice job completed for tenant_id=981234, billing_period=2025-11, used_rows=29, manifest_ref=export-prod-2025-11-20-07:05 (automated note).
Jordan (data-eng): Okay manifest_ref timestamp is 2025-11-20 07:05 UTC — that suggests the manifest was generated after UTC midnight for some regions. If export worker skipped a shard due to transient DB timeout we could have an empty CSV but later backfill populated the ledger (dashboard reads ledger), so dashboard > CSV.
Priya N.: I'm pulling logs now. Quick grep shows: hourly-aggregator shard-7 log 2025-11-19T23:58:12Z ERROR "commit failed: write timeout to export_store". Worker retried but backfill job happened only at 2025-11-20T02:40:05Z. The export manifest generation ran at 07:05 and didn't pick up the late backfill because it reads the export_store snapshot taken at 07:00.
Ashley M.: So customer downloaded CSV earlier and saw empty file. They reached out before backfill completed. Invoice later also missed it because invoice job pulled the manifest snapshot that predated the backfill.
Matt R.: That matches. Can we confirm whether backfill writes to export_store but not to manifest snapshot index? Jordan?
Jordan (data-eng): Yes — export_store has two paths: live-append (ledger) and snapshot index used by manifest generation. Our backfill writes ledger but we only refresh the snapshot index every 6 hours by default. On this tenant that refresh cycle didn't run until 02:40 (after the manifest snapshot at 07:00? note UTC confusion — will double-check times).
Priya N.: Repro steps for team: 1) reproduce by forcing an export_store write failure on shard-7 during 23:58 UTC window (dev-only). 2) run backfill to ledger after 02:00 UTC. 3) run manifest generation at 07:00 and confirm snapshot miss.
Ashley M.: Immediate ask from customer: can we re-run a recompute / re-manifest for 2025-11-19 and provide them the corrected CSV + corrective invoice?
Matt R.: Yes. Proposed remediation: a) run manifest recompute for tenant 981234 for 2025-11-19 (reads ledger, generates full CSVs), b) re-run invoice generation in sandbox and produce credit if necessary, c) add a near-term fix to make manifest generation detect recent backfills within last 6h for affected tenants.
Jordan (data-eng): I can trigger recompute now for that tenant and day. Doing: `./tools/recompute_manifest --tenant 981234 --date 2025-11-19 --force`
billing-bot: Recompute job queued: job_id=rcmp-20251121-3345, queued_by=Jordan, estimated_time=2m.
Priya N.: After recompute finishes, I'll upload corrected CSV to the customer's S3 path with suffix `-recomputed` and update the portal link. Ashley, send them the link+apology and say invoice adjustment is pending.
Ashley M.: will do. Also can we add monitoring alert: if manifest file size == 0 and dashboard_tokens > X then auto-flag? This would avoid customers discovering gaps.
Matt R.: Good idea. Add rule in exports-monitoring: compare manifest shard sizes to ledger token counts for same period. I'll make a ticket.
Jordan (data-eng): Follow-ups: 1) we'll instrument manifest generator to check for backfill timestamps and optionally wait up to 15m for recent backfills for tenants with >50k tokens in previous day. 2) ops should consider bumping snapshot refresh cadence for high-traffic tenants.
Priya N.: Recompute finished — uploaded file at s3://redwood-exports/prod/tenant-ACME/2025-11-19/usage-ACME-2025-11-19-recomputed.csv (size 1.2MB). Also kicked off billing re-run in sandbox to compute delta.
Ashley M.: Thanks team — I sent the S3 link to the customer and told them we'll follow up with billing outcome. Closing here after billing confirms invoice adjustment. :pray:
